messages.subject: errors in math/matrix.hpp
parts:
All of the mean, variance and sd functions had
the same bug -- delcaring a double return type
for a function templated on type T, meaning
they wouldn't work with agrad::var inputs.

I'm fixing them and adding tests. I
will push a patch ASAP.

- Bob
